label: Conference · October 2026
title: GSAI at BRACIS/ENIAC 2026 in Cuiabá
paragraphs: Members of GSAI participated in BRACIS/ENIAC 2026 in Cuiabá, presenting recent research on autonomous driving, Bird’s-Eye View perception, and learning-based control.

The group presented work on closed-loop evaluation of BEV maps generated by Cross-View Transformers for behavior-cloning policies, a low-cost miniature Ackermann platform for end-to-end autonomous driving, and diffusion-based open-loop control under dry friction and stiction.

label: Approved CNPq Universal Project
title: Policy Learning for Autonomous Vehicle Navigation
paragraphsHtml: The project investigates advanced imitation learning approaches for autonomous driving, including GAIL, energy-based models, and diffusion models, combined with Bird’s-Eye View (BEV) representations. The main objective is to improve generalization beyond traditional behavior cloning in dynamic, multimodal urban driving scenarios. Experiments are conducted in CARLA and transferred to a miniature vehicle operating on simulated urban tracks and real campus sidewalks.
